product: One purchased factory-sealed 100 g plain Japanese Camellia sinensis sencha, steamed/rolled/dried, posted to an individual for own consumption.
sourceAuthority: Secrétariat Général du Gouvernement, official Journal Officiel archive linked from current SGG home page
publication: Spécial Textes Législatifs et Règlementaires Juillet 2021, published 30 July 2021
law: Loi ordinaire L/2021/033/AN du 04 juillet 2021 portant contrôle des denrées, marchandises et services alimentaires et répression des fraudes commerciales

promulgation.effect: Law Article 68 takes effect on promulgation; decree Articles 1–2 promulgate it with effect on signature, 21 July 2021.

provisions.finding: General scope expressly includes all importing activities, alongside production, processing, manufacture, transport, distribution and sale. No general private-food exception appears in the complete Act.

provisions.exactText: introduction depuis un pays étranger vers le territoire national par tout moyen
provisions.finding: This scope does not exclude air post or private consumers by its wording.

terms: établissement ou exploitant du secteur alimentaire
provisions.finding: Food enterprise and operator definitions expressly include nonprofit activities. Volunteer status is not a blanket exemption.

Administrative operating authorizations concern slaughterhouses and food businesses active in production, processing or distribution. This clause is not a clear personal recipient registration requirement.

Market-food labeling/information includes certificate of origin among its items. Article 4 defines that certificate in terms of exports produced, manufactured or processed in Guinea; this odd wording is not a defensible stand-alone Japanese origin-certificate duty for personal post.
ONCQ is the principal national control organ for foods and consumer goods placed on the market.

provisions.exactText: Les denrées alimentaires d’origine industrielle, y compris les boissons, font l’objet d’un contrôle de qualité préalable à l’autorisation de mise à la consommation (AMC).
provisions.finding: Industrial food, including beverages, undergoes quality control before authorization for consumption. Factory-manufactured retail sencha is within the ordinary industrial-food description; tea need not be named for this inference.

provisions.exactText: Les modalités d’exécution et la certification des contrôles officiels sont fixées par voie règlementaire.
provisions.finding: Execution details and certification of official controls are delegated to regulations. The Act does not state a foreign origin document or advance application for this personal parcel.

Control results are notified in writing to the person responsible for the enterprise, with compliance, recall, confiscation, closure or rejection measures. This context admits an arrival-control/release interpretation of AMC; it does not establish that the store must procure an origin certificate.

provisions.exactText: Quiconque importe, exporte, produit, transforme, distribue, entrepose ou transporte des denrées alimentaires sans autorisation ou impropres à la consommation humaine et animale, est passible d’un emprisonnement de 5 mois à 1 an et d’une amende égale à la valeur des marchandises incriminées.
provisions.finding: A real broad penalty for unauthorized food import exists. It does not specify the authorization application, timing or foreign documentation; read with Articles 40 and 44, it cannot alone identify special advance paperwork rather than local arrival clearance.

assessment.confidence: High confidence in recovered wording and authentication; unresolved operative paperwork classification for this private postal route.
assessment.strongestExclusionArgument: Articles 2 and 4 cover import by any means, Article 40 affirmatively subjects industrial food to AMC, and Article 52 penalizes unauthorized import. These are actual duties, not merely enabling powers; no personal exception is stated in this Act.
assessment.whyNoForcedExclusion: The user permits ordinary arrival declarations and inspection. The Act does not distinguish AMC issued after routine control from a separate prior approval, and it does not prescribe sender-procured certificates for this parcel. Treating every local release authorization as forbidden special paperwork would expand the user constraint.
assessment.strongestPermissionArgument: The personal recipient is not automatically a food establishment under Article 26, and official inspection/release could be routine. However that possibility is not an established special-document-free route; neither Article 40 nor the later BNIQ order affirmatively resolves the private parcel.
assessment.remainingEvidence: A current operative AMC/private-post procedure or general exception showing whether this parcel uses ordinary arrival clearance only; and resolution of BNIQ Order A/2024/920 Article 3 transport scope plus the Article 4/5 private non-sale exemption. No bespoke tea letter is intrinsically needed.
assessment.bniqConsistency: Reread saved signed Order A/2024/920 Articles 2–6 and organization Order A/2024/1102 Article 3. The latter gives BNIQ power to examine and approve exemptions; it does not itself impose an exemption application on every individual. The former names containers, trucks and other international rolling transport, then mixes are exempt with may be exempt for private/non-sale goods. It has separate electronic declaration and foreign-document duties if covered. Law 2021 does not settle those later clauses.
assessment.paperworkType: Actual AMC food quality-control/release authorization established; advance application/foreign-document classification for private post remains unresolved. Ordinary arrival inspection is not treated as a forbidden certificate.
